notes: Module lines in the SVT now show their description also when the car has newer software than your PSdZData (some CAFD and SWFK lines stayed bare), and an SVT opened from a file on a G20 and similar cars names every part again. The Flash assistant checks before flashing that your PSdZData has every flash file the job needs: a Lite PSdZData or missing files are named before E-Sys would stop part way. FSC status reads when E-Sys is connected but the car's VIN is not shown yet (remote sessions). Full backup never saves an older SVT under the connected car's VIN and does not open a second connection to the car when E-Sys's own one gives no fault list. Writing the vehicle order checks the order E-Sys will really write, says no before anything is changed when the car or E-Sys is not ready, and the offer comes back after a refusal of the moment. A save clicked right after an edit always goes to the MODIFIED copy.
